summary: Iteration 3 backend tests: 25/26 passed (96%). Verified grant-pro (1day/1week/1month/permanent/custom), revoke-pro, role-based 403, player-config public endpoint + admin-settings persistence, subtitle .vtt regression (no SameFileError) and .srt auto-convert, and full migration JSON output structure (users=2544, videos=1420, categories=19). One real bug discovered in /api/videos/{id}/subtitles: for .vtt uploads, rel_orig is NOT being persisted as None as intended.

minor.issue: BUG: rel_orig should be null for .vtt uploads per the fix intent (server.py:1158 sets rel_orig=None inside `if ext == '.vtt'`), but lines 1168-1169 unconditionally re-assign `rel_orig = f"subtitles/{orig_name}"`, overriding the None. Functional regression of SameFileError IS fixed (upload returns 200, format='vtt', file plays), but the DB `original_url` field is populated with the same path as `url`, so when a Wasabi upload runs (line 1170-1181), it will upload the same .vtt file twice (once as text/vtt, once as text/plain) and the second call will overwrite the first because both use the same key. In local-storage mode the duplicate URL is harmless but semantically wrong (sub.original_url should be null since there's no non-vtt 'original').
minor.fix_hint:
Move `rel_vtt = ...` / `rel_orig = ...` defaults INSIDE the else-branch, or set them before the if and only assign rel_orig when ext != '.vtt'. Suggested patch: replace lines 1153-1169 with:
    vtt_name = f"{video_id}_{sub_id}.vtt"
    vtt_path = UPLOAD_DIR / 'subtitles' / vtt_name
    if ext == '.vtt':
        rel_orig = None
        rel_vtt = f'subtitles/{orig_name}'   # the uploaded file already IS the vtt
    else:
        proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(...)
        await proc.wait()
        if not vtt_path.exists():
            raise HTTPException(500, 'Subtitle conversion failed')
        rel_vtt = f'subtitles/{vtt_name}'
        rel_orig = f'subtitles/{orig_name}'
    Also gate the wasabi `url_orig` upload behind `if rel_orig:`.

action_items: Fix /app/backend/server.py:1168-1169 so rel_orig stays None for .vtt uploads and the wasabi `original_url` second upload is skipped when rel_orig is None.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1305 lines — close to the 700-line guideline ceiling x2. Consider splitting routers (auth, admin, videos, subtitles, payments, site) into separate modules.
Subtitle endpoint mixes local/Wasabi upload logic in one 60+ line function; refactor `wasabi_upload` branch into a helper.

Grant-pro endpoint accepts an untyped `payload: dict` — switch to a Pydantic model (e.g., GrantProReq) for input validation. `int(payload.get('custom_days') or 1)` will TypeError if a non-int string is passed.

`pro_expires_at` is stored as the literal string 'permanent' for permanent grants but as ISO datetime strings otherwise. Mixing sentinel string + datetime in same field is fragile (consumers must special-case it). Consider `pro_expires_at: Optional[datetime]` + separate `pro_lifetime: bool` field.

Migration output `legacy_id_maps.json` has correct counts metadata; user/video schemas validated (password_hash starts with $2b$, renditions list non-empty, status='ready', uploader_id/category_id mapped).

rca of the issue: Bug: .vtt subtitle upload — `original_url` is wrongly populated. Reproduction: POST /api/videos/{id}/subtitles with a file whose suffix is .vtt and Content-Type text/vtt + raw 'WEBVTT\n\n00:00...' body. Expected per fix intent (server.py:1158): sub.original_url == None. Actual: sub.original_url == 'subtitles/{video_id}_{sub_id}.vtt' (identical to sub.url). Root cause: at server.py lines 1153-1169, the variables `rel_vtt` and `rel_orig` are assigned unconditionally AFTER the `if ext == '.vtt': rel_orig = None / else: ffmpeg-convert` block, so the None set inside the if-branch is immediately overwritten. Mitigation: move rel_vtt/rel_orig assignment into each branch (see fix_hint in backend_issues.minor[0]) and gate `await wasabi_upload(...rel_orig...)` behind `if rel_orig:`.
